chunks: And from him (Al-Hurr al-Amili) from Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ibrahim from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir, a companion of the Imams known for transmitting hadiths
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Ali ibn Ibrahim, a prominent narrator in Shia hadith collections
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Like it, indicating the preceding text or ruling applies here

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithluhu' indicate in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This is a brief hadith from the book Tahdhib al-Ahkam, indicating that the ruling or narration previously cited applies equally to this chain. It serves as a reference link within the chapter on permissible wives.
